tasks.title: Implement Product Management Functions
tasks.description: Develop functionality allowing store owners and sales personnel to create and update product records.

tasks.title: Implement Customer Account Management
tasks.description: Develop functionality allowing store owners and sales personnel to create and update customer account records.

tasks.title: Implement Catalog Browsing
tasks.description: Develop catalog browsing interface accessible to users without mandatory sign-in.

tasks.title: Implement Shopping Cart Logic
tasks.description: Develop shopping cart capabilities including addition of products, quantity adjustment to positive integers, and item removal.

tasks.title: Implement Order Submission Flow
tasks.description: Develop order submission logic that forces sign-in, prevents empty cart submission, creates an order record, and displays a reference number.
